and not exists ( select 1 from sys_index_menu tim where tim.del_flag = '0' and tim.menu_id = t1.menu_id and tim.user_id = #{userId} ) and not exists ( select 1 from sys_menu t3 where t3.menu_type = 'C' and t3.parent_id = t1.menu_id )
and t1.menu_name like concat('%',#{menuName},'%')
and t2.menu_name like concat('%',#{menuName2},'%')
order by t2.parent_id,t2.order_num,t1.order_num,t1.menu_id
